senses.gloss:
पेश पेश, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. पिश्), Ved. =
पेशस्, q. v.; [cf. पुरु-प्˚.]

पेष पेष, अस्, m. (fr. rt. पिष्), pounding,
grinding; [cf. शिला-प्˚.]

पेशन, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. well formed, well made;
decorated, adorned.

पेशल, अस्, आ, अम्, artificially formed, adorned,
decorated; beautiful, charming, lovely, pleasant;
soft, smooth, tender; skilful, dexterous, expert,
clever, ingenious; fraudulent, deceitful, crafty; (अम्),
n. beauty, loveliness; [cf. Gr. ποικ-ίλο-ς, ποικἰλλ-ω:
Lat. ping-o, pic-tor, pic-tura: Old Germ. feh,
‘variegated:’ Slav. pĭstrŭ, ‘variegated;’ pis-ati,
‘to write:’ Lith. pisz-nu-s, ‘splendid.’]
—पेशल-
त्व, अम्, n. dexterity, skill.
—पेशल-मध्य, अस्,
आ, अम्, slender-waisted, having a delicate or slender
waist.
पेषल पेषल, अस्, आ, अम्, = पेशल, q. v.
पेसल पेसल = पेशल, q. v.

पेशस्, अस्, n., Ved. shape, form; an artificial figure,
ornament, decoration, embroidery; variety of colour,
brilliance; gold; [cf. अश्व-प्˚, ऋत-प्˚.]
—पेशस्-
कारी, f., Ved. a woman who weaves artistically or
embroiders.
—पेशस्-कृत्, त्, m. ‘the artist,’ an epi-
thet of the hand; a species of insect, a kind of wasp.
—पेशस्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. decorated, adorned,
ornamented.

पेशि, इस्, m. a thunderbolt (for पेषि); (इस्), f. an
egg; split pease.

पेशी, f. a piece of flesh or meat [cf. पिशित]; a
ball or mass of flesh; the fetus shortly after con-
ception; a muscle (of which there are said to be five
hundred in the human body); the peel or rind (of
fruit); a kind of drum; a sheath, scabbard; a shoe;
the egg of a bird; spikenard, Valeriana Jatamansi;
a blown bud; N. of a Piśācī; of a Rākṣasī; of a
river.
—पेशी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते,
[]
-कर्तुम्, to cut into pieces, to carve.
—पेशी-कोश or
पेशी-कोष, अस्, m. a bird's egg.
—पेश्य्-अण्ड, अम्,
n. a bird's egg; a piece of flesh; the fetus shortly
after conception.
पेषि, इस्, m. a thunderbolt.

पेषी पेषी, f., Ved. (according to Sāy.) =
हिंसिका, पिशाचिका, a malevolent spirit, female Pi-
śāca; (perhaps) a nurse; spikenard (in this sense a
various reading for पेशी, q. v.).
—पेषी-कृ, a various
reading for पेशी-कृ, q. v.
पेशिका, f. (fr. पेशी), rind, shell (of fruit).

पेशितृ, ता, m., Ved. one who cuts in pieces or
carves, a carver.

पेश्वर, अस्, आ, अम् (? for पेष्वर fr. rt. पिष्),
who or what grinds.

पेस्वर, अस्, आ, अम्, going, moving; destructive;
splendid.

पेष् पेष् [cf. rt. येष्], cl. 1. A. पेषते,
पेषितुम्, to exert one's self or strive
diligently.

पेस् पेस् (= rt. पिस्), cl. 1. P. पेसति,
पेसितुम्, to go, move.

पेषक, अस्, इका, अम्, one who pounds or grinds,
a grinder, grinding, pounding, pulverizing, masti-
cating.

पेषाक, अस्, m. a small slab for grinding anything
upon, a grind-stone.

पेषण, अम्, n. pounding, grinding, crushing,
triturating, pulverizing by means of a mill, (पेषणं
या, to be ground); a threshing-floor; a hand-mill,
a stone and muller, any apparatus for grinding or
pounding; a plant, a species of Euphorbia with three
lobes, Euphorbia Antiquorum (= शत-गुप्ता, Ben-
gālī तेकाटोसिज).
—पेषण-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, a word
formed for the explanation of पिपिष्वत्.

पेषणि, इस्, ई, f. a stone slab on which condi-
ments are ground, a muller, mill-stone, grind-stone.

पेषणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be ground or pounded,
fit to be ground or pulverized.

पेष्टृ, टा, ट्री, टृ, one who pounds or crushes,
one who grinds, a grinder.

पेष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be pounded or ground, to
be triturated or pulverized.

पेष्ट्र पेष्ट्र, अम्, n. (perhaps fr. rt. 1. पिश्),
Ved. a bone.

पेसुक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. पिस्), Ved. spreading,
extending.
